events.description: Rio Buenavista overflowed at the Buenavista-Pasaje road (Pasaje) after rain from Sunday night 22 Feb to the early hours of Monday 23 Feb 2026; water entered banana areas. Same night the Machala-Santa Rosa road was closed by an overflowing river. In the demo farm's catchment.

sources.citation: El Universo, 23 Feb 2026, 'Inundaciones en Machala y desbordamientos de rios paralizan parte de El Oro este 23 de febrero'

notes: Counts, not skill: 4 press-documented floods (D-024; 1 in the farm's catchment, 3 regional), period 2026-01-01..2026-11-13, alert = a demo lot at Severe; a hit needs Severe from 1 UTC day before to 1 day after the local flood dates. False alarm = Severe episode with no documented flood in this list, not proof that no flood happened. Replay window 2026-02-15..2026-03-05: hits 1, misses 0, false alarms 0. Weights are design (no expert AHP). SENSITIVITY (T-024b): each weight moved by +/-0.10 and the rest renormalised, 10 variants, replay re-run. Baseline demo lots at Severe (UTC days): 1: 02-15..03-05; 2: 02-15..03-05; 3: 02-15..02-20, 02-24..03-05; 4: 02-15..03-05; 5: 02-15..03-05; 7: 02-15..03-05; 8: 02-15..03-05. Strict result (same lots, same days): NOT STABLE in 9 of 10 variants: upstream +0.10: gains lot 6 | upstream -0.10: loses lot 3; days shift for lot 8 | saturation +0.10: gains lot 6; days shift for lot 3 | saturation -0.10: loses lot 3; days shift for lot 8 | terrain +0.10: loses lot 3, 8; days shift for lot 5 | terrain -0.10: gains lot 6; days shift for lot 3 | local -0.10: loses lot 3; days shift for lot 8 | balance +0.10: gains lot 6 | balance -0.10: loses lot 3; days shift for lot 8. Flood days 02-21..02-24: lots at Severe in the baseline: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8; the same set in 1 of 10 variants; Severe on those days in every variant: lots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7; in at least one variant: lots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
